description: React component for an 'Add Channels' button in the sidebar, allowing users to browse or create channels with permission checks and modal interactions.

methods.name: showMoreChannelsModal
methods.description: Dispatches action to open the 'Browse Channels' modal.

methods.name: showNewChannelModal
methods.description: Dispatches action to open the 'New Channel' modal.

methods.name: renderDropdownItems
methods.description: Generates menu items for browsing or creating channels based on permissions.

methods.name: storePreferencesAndTrackEvent
methods.description: Saves user preference indicating the 'Add Channels' CTA was touched.

methods.name: handleMenuToggle
methods.description: Handles menu toggle event, tracking when menu is opened.
